decision.reason: The previous checkpoints store attribute-classification heads, not identity/ReID embedding weights. Their PA-100K and synthetic proxy scores cannot be converted into CCTV identity Rank-1.
decision.required_next_run: Train an identity projection/ReID head or jointly fine-tune the encoder on identityGroupId/track-heldout labels, then run the same CHIRLA/project contract.
decision.bubble_chart_policy: Do not plot missing Rank-1 as zero. Keep these artifacts in this eligibility audit until identity evaluation is actually run.

what_can_be_reused: The old attribute heads can be reused as auxiliary supervision after adding an identity projection and reviewed identity labels.
The Sonnet response-level labels can be retained as an attribute loss; this is not logit KD.
The old PA-100K metrics remain valid for the old attribute task and should not be relabeled as CCTV identity accuracy.
what_must_be_rerun: For each arm, train identity projection/ReID supervision with identityGroupId and track-heldout split.
Evaluate Rank-1, Recall@5, Recall@10, mAP, open-set false-match rate and abstention on the same gallery/query contract.

Run the same identity training and evaluation for CLIP ViT-L/14 baseline, CLIP attribute-hard initialization, CLIP SOLIDER-KD initialization, SOLIDER attribute baseline and SOLIDER+Sonnet attribute supervision.
